title: Pre-check and connect a server with azcmagent and a service principal
summary: Check endpoint reachability from the server, then connect it with the onboarding service principal, tags and automatic agent upgrade.
code:
# 1. Pre-check from the machine (add --enable-pls-check for Private Link, --extensions all for extension endpoints)
azcmagent check --location westeurope

# 2. Connect. Fetch the secret at run time from a vault or secure variable; never store it in the script.
azcmagent connect --service-principal-id <appId> --service-principal-secret <secret> --tenant-id <tenant> --subscription-id <sub> --resource-group rg-arc-prod-weu --location westeurope --tags "Environment=Prod,Site=STO1,PatchRing=ProdA" --enable-automatic-upgrade

# 3. Verify
azcmagent show
notes: The Windows onboarding script only runs in 64-bit Windows PowerShell; some RMM tools start 32-bit PowerShell.
Exit codes mirror the AZCM error codes (26 = network, 41 = credentials, 44 = name already exists): log them per wave.
